subject: AWS co-sell intake: Meditech procurement & joint-account roadmap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Khan <maya@meditech.solutions>, Liam Cross <liam.cross@amazon.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30 09:12 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell intake: Meditech procurement & joint-account roadmap

Hi Maya / Liam —

Great to meet both of you on Tuesday. Per our conversation I want to kick off a short intake thread so we can land three things this week: (1) procurement timeline and PO workflow, (2) a lightweight mutual action plan for the AWS co-sell, and (3) a technical readiness checklist for the marketplace listing.

I attached a draft MA Plan (spreadsheet) and a short security summary to help procurement and your cloud team. Could you confirm:
- Target procurement window (PO / SOW sign) — date range works best
- Who on your side needs an MSA-level redline (name + email)
- Any mandatory procurement forms or purchase requisition codes we should populate in the MA Plan

Tentative next steps from our side: Jonas will build a 4-week intake sprint (ops + enablement) and Kimberly will scope the listing requirements for AWS Marketplace (entitlements, metering if applicable). Vanessa will coordinate legal handoff if you have a contract redline.

Available times to sync (PT): Thu 10:00–11:00, Fri 09:00–10:30. If procurement needs a separate slot, we can schedule that after you confirm the team.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: Meditech_MutualActionPlan_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet), Meditech_Security_Summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Maya Khan <maya@meditech.solutions>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Liam Cross <liam.cross@amazon.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@meditech.solutions>
Date: 2028-05-30 11:28 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intake: Meditech procurement & joint-account roadmap

Thanks Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers:
- Procurement target: aiming to complete PO and internal approvals by the runbook week of Jun 12–16 (target sign 2028-06-15). We need vendor W-9 + standard MSA; our legal will do redlines.
- Redline contact: Priya Natarajan (cc'd on procurement) — priya.n@meditech.solutions
- Req code: MED-2028-OPS-44 (please include in the MA Plan)

We also have two technical asks for marketplace listing: single-tenant image availability (we prefer VPC option), and usage metrics for metered billing — our product ops will review the metering model.

Can do Thu 10:00 PT for a short sync; if procurement wants a separate meeting I will propose Tue Jun 6 09:00 PT.

Best,
Maya Khan
Director, Product Partnerships | Meditech Solutions
maya@meditech.solutions | +1 (617) 555-1920

--
Procurement Team included for visibility on MSA and PO requirements.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30 12:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intake: Meditech procurement & joint-account roadmap

Looping in ops notes and initial sprint outline.

Quick summary of actions I will take:  
- Draft a 4-week intake sprint in the MA Plan: Week 0 = procurement + legal; Week 1 = security gating + listing artifacts; Week 2 = staging demo + performance baseline; Week 3 = GTM enablement + co-sell kickoff.
- Populate the req code MED-2028-OPS-44 into the spreadsheet and add a procurement checklist column (W-9, COI, PO template).
- Work with Kimberly on a minimal listing runbook: images, entitlement model, marketplace SKU mapping, and a short metering example.

Kimberly — can you confirm whether we need: a) a marketplace metering hook or b) a consumption-only listing? If metering is required, estimate engineering effort (SWE + infra) so we can reflect in the MA Plan.

Vanessa — FYI I attached an internal pointer to our MSA redline playbook; if legal needs a fast-track we can offer a limited pilot to avoid a full enterprise MSA at first.

Jonas
Cloud Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

Attachment: (internal) redwood_msa-draft.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maya Khan <maya@meditech.solutions>, Liam Cross <liam.cross@amazon.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@meditech.solutions>
Date: 2028-06-01 15:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intake: Meditech procurement & joint-account roadmap

Perfect — thanks for the quick replies. Confirming next items consolidated here: 
1) Target sign: 2028-06-15 (Procurement code MED-2028-OPS-44 added to MA Plan).
2) Legal contact: Priya Natarajan (we will send MSA redline and a one-page pilot SOW by EOD Tue Jun 5).
3) Technical asks: Kimberly will follow up on single-tenant / VPC packaging and provide a short metering example by Wed Jun 7.
4) Meetings: Thu May 31 10:00 PT confirmed for intake (we will record decisions); separate procurement review Tue Jun 6 09:00 PT pending Priya's confirmation.

Immediate deliverables from Redwood (timeline):
- Updated MA Plan with procurement checklist and req code — Jonas (EOD Mon Jun 4).
- Draft pilot SOW + MSA redline send — Vanessa (EOD Tue Jun 5).
- Technical packaging note + metering example — Kimberly (Wed Jun 7).

Maya — cc'ing Liam from AWS so he can help coordinate a joint account plan and introduce the AWS GTM contact who will join the co-sell announcement. If there's anyone else from your exec sponsor team who should be on the call, please add them.

Thanks — we'll treat this as a tight intake sprint to align onboarding and the marketplace listing.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0148
